dimensions.name: Governance Awareness
dimensions.rationale: The trace includes a dedicated rules-context-loader step that successfully validated schema, indicating governance rules were loaded and integrated. All subsequent reasoning spans completed with schema validation success, demonstrating consistent alignment with defined rules.

The alignment-engine further analyzes cause-effect relationships within the architecture, and both steps executed successfully with no errors.

dimensions.name: Architectural Tension Analysis

Successful schema validation and completion of these steps indicate effective surfacing and resolution of tensions, with generated intent reflecting balanced decisions.
